title: Harborline Customer Accounts Service Entitlements by Tier
content:
# Service entitlements by tier

> Harborline Customer Accounts

Alongside its discounts, each account tier carries the team, API and support entitlements below. Each figure is the entitlement of the tier the account currently holds.

| Tier | Team member logins with delegated access (largest number) | Reseller API enabled | API calls allowed per minute | Billing end clients through sub-accounts | Priority support queue for calls and chats | Named account manager | First human response on a ticket (elapsed hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Personal Account | 1 | No | 0 | No | No | No | 24 |
| Harborline Business Account | 5 | No | 0 | No | Yes | No | 12 |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | 10 | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes | No | 8 |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | 25 | Yes | 60 | Yes | Yes | No | 6 |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | 50 | Yes | 120 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 4 |
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | 100 | Yes | 240 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 2 |

## Reading the schedule

- The API rate is 0 calls per minute on a tier where the reseller API is not enabled.
- The response figure is in elapsed hours within which a ticket receives its first human response.
- Priority support means calls and chats route to the priority support queue.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

An agency on Harborline Reseller Silver may have up to 25 team member logins with delegated access and up to 60 API calls per minute; on Harborline Business Account the same agency would have up to 5 logins and no reseller API.
